english: a friend in need is a friend indeed

terms.latin: Is est amīcus quī in rē dubiā rē juvat.
terms.comment: Literally “he is a friend who helps in deed in a doubtful matter”. We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
